notes: Intro timer at or below zero (0, -1, -0x8000) and positive (1, 5, 0xc8, 0x7fff, random); followed object absent or present with 0x8c064 returning AL 1, 0, 2 or 1 with dirty upper bits. 0xd0b68 runs for real; the angle updates (AX/DX logged), the lookup 0x95660, 0x8c064, 0x9357c and 0x95018 are loggers.
